title: update_last_message_at swallows failure with no log
description: message.rs:473-476: the update_last_message_at call after message insert uses let _ = ... with a comment that it is intentional. However there is no tracing::warn! on failure, so a persistently failing update (e.g. chats row deleted) is invisible in production logs. Chat.lastMessageAt becomes silently stale with no way to observe the condition. Add tracing::warn! with the error.
